text:
Maya: quick sync — sales says BigBank is asking to stay on galactica-v1 for another 6 months. they want a contractual pin. this collides with our v2 migration window. thoughts?
Priya: why do they want v1 pinned? perf, accuracy, hallucinations?
Jenna: they reported a spike in hallucinations & instruction-following regressions on v2 for their legal summarization templates. CS pulled sample prompts.
Omar: infra note: v1 uses unquantized weights and eats more memory. we have reserved pools for current customers, but extending pinning increases cost and reduces headroom for v2 canaries.
Lucas: support ticket #98321 has the customer's failing prompts and examples. they're small but recurrent.
Priya: can we reproduce? request: add their prompt set to our nightly benchmark runner and run an A/B on v1 vs v2 with our eval metrics.
Maya: timeline constraint — sales needs a yes/no for contract term by EOD. propose triage flow: 1) smoke eval w/ customer's prompts within 24h. 2) if metric delta >5% (customer's primary metric) -> grant temporary 30-day pin with telemetry + canary. 3) if delta <=5% -> provide remediation plan and encourage migration.
Omar: agree on triage but we also need to capture p95 latency & cost delta. numbers from current runs: v1 p95 ~420ms, v2 p95 ~210ms; cost per 1M tokens ~ $X (v1) vs ~$0.55*X (v2) — rough. pin increases monthly committed spend.
Priya: suggested eval metrics: Exact-Answer F1 (customer-labeled), hallucination rate (manual/annotated), instruction-following score. include example output capture to verify deterministic differences. e.g.:
```
PROMPT: "Summarize policy X for legal team"
v1: "Summary paragraph A (accurate)"
v2: "Summary paragraph B (missing clause)"
```
Maya: can we automate the annotation path for quick triage? even a 1-annotator pass would be helpful for initial decision.
Jenna: CS can surface prioritized prompts and provide 2 annotators for quick label pass. we can also offer BigBank a temporary SOW to fund extended pin if they want guaranteed runway.
Lucas: support ops note — need a per-customer route flag and a clear TTL on pins. no permanent exceptions. suggest default pin TTL = 30 days + one 30-day renewal if remediation progress.
Omar: ops-wise we need a canary rollout plan: cohort 0 = 2% traffic for 48h with enhanced logs, cohort 1 = 10% for 72h, then expand. if errors or hallucination regressions detected, automatic fallback to v1. deploy-bot can orchestrate.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: model=galactica-v1, target=BigBank, cohort=2%, window=48h — awaiting manual start. :rocket:
Maya: owners: Priya (eval triage + metrics), Omar (canary + infra cost impact), Jenna (customer comms + SOW), Lucas (support ops + routing). I'll own the decision and comm back to sales after triage.
Priya: will kick off benchmark run now and share results in this thread within 18h.
Omar: I'll prepare rollback policy & cost delta spreadsheet and tag finance.
Jenna: I'll draft the customer comm template and the temporary SOW wording.
Lucas: prepping support flag + routing change; will need a short maintenance window.
Maya: thanks — if results show >5% regression we'll grant a 30-day pin with telemetry gating and renewal only if remediation is underway. closing loop in this thread.
deploy-bot: job update: benchmark-run queued (run-id: br-2024-171867). will post results to thread when complete.
